jobs.occupation: Finance Head (f/m/d) - Discrete Projects Industrial Logistics (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
We're seeking a Finance Head (f/m/d) for Industrial Logistics within Digital Industries Automation Discrete Projects (DI AUT DP). In this role, you'll lead global financial management for our Industrial Logistics (IL) project business across Europe and Americas – as part of the global Finance function under our new ONE Tech Company structure.
This is your chance to shape financial operations throughout the complete project lifecycle – from bid calculations to project closure – while ensuring IFRS 15 compliance, financial performance analysis, and effective risk management. You’ll drive profitable growth, sustainable margin improvement, stable cash generation, and financial resilience through disciplined risk control across multiple countries. You'll work in a transformation environment with a clear focus on business growth, where your financial expertise directly contributes to our goals of speed, scale, and efficiency.
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.
You’ll make an impact by - Financial Leadership & Strategy: You lead global financial management and controlling for the Industrial Logistics project business, reporting to the Head of Finance of DI AUT DP. You drive growth and productivity initiatives to strengthen its competitive position. You govern the adoption of finance and controlling policies and guidelines based on the overall FIN strategy while ensuring compliance with all relevant financial regulations (external and internal).- Budget Planning, Forecasting & Financial Reporting: You coordinate budget planning and forecasting for the entire IL project business, ensuring IFRS-compliant accounting and timely preparation of financial closings as well as accurate books and records (monthly, quarterly, annual).- Performance Monitoring: You monitor and comment on financial performance (current development and outlook) incl. KPI analyses and performance reporting. You analyze, approve, review and forecast project revenues and costs, and ensure accurate profitability throughout the project lifecycle, as well as initiate early warnings to stakeholders when needed.- Project Finance & Risk Management: You identify and manage financial risks associated with the execution of projects, including currency, credit, and operational risks, ensuring proper risk assessment and provisioning in calculations and financial statements.- Operational Improvement & Innovation: You identify operational improvement potentials in controlling and financial processes, propose solutions and remedial measures, and drive productivity improvements through automation and innovation initiatives.- Collaboration & Transformation: You work with IL management, operational leadership, and central finance functions while supporting organizational transformation by challenging the current processes and collaborating across all stakeholder groups (e.g., FIN, P&O, EHS, GBS, SCM).- Team Leadership & Development: Finally, you manage and develop Finance and Controlling teams supporting the global IL project business. Traveling to its locations and project sites is necessary.

Your success is grounded in- Education: University degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field - Experience and Skills:- Minimum 8-10 years in Finance, Controlling, and FP&A, preferably in international project business- Minimum 5 years leadership experience leading finance teams across multiple locations and building collaborative relationships - Proven expertise in IFRS 15 revenue recognition for long-term project contracts and commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations. Familiarity with project business models in automotive or comparable industrial environments is a strong differentiator.- Demonstrated hands-on experience in commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations, covering pricing structures, risk allocation, liability caps, and penalty/malus clauses. Ability to engage with customer purchasing teams and to represent Finance as a value-creating business partner in complex commercial discussions.- Strong knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and controlling- Deep understanding of risk management, internal controls, compliance and audit requirements- Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP preferred) and advanced MS Office skills- Experience with organizational transformation and implementation of new business operations is beneficial

- Ways of Working:- Strategic vision meets financial excellence – combining big-picture thinking with process optimization and attention to detail- Collaborative influencer who builds trust across cultures and translates complex financial insights into clear, actionable messages- Proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in evolving business environments - High integrity with commitment to Siemens Business Conduct Guidelines and compliance requirements
- Languages: Business proficiency in English; German language skills are a plus. Additional languages are highly welcome and beneficial for international collaboration.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us. As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/about/social-commitments/belonging/) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.
About us.
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

You start your day by working with stakeholders across the PLM/S4HANA digital transformation program and the Clarification & Logistics organization. You collaborate with subject matter experts, process owners, business leaders, and project teams to align business requirements, optimize service and logistics processes, and support organizational readiness. Throughout the day, you facilitate workshops, contribute to process harmonization and solution design activities, monitor user adoption, and provide leadership updates. Your role combines business transformation, process management, change management, and digitalization to ensure the successful implementation of PLM360 and SAP S/4HANA solutions across a global service organization.

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Central coordination of business transformation and digital transformation activities between the PLM/S4HANA Get Ready Team and the Clarification & Logistics organization, ensuring alignment of business priorities, requirements, and deployment readiness
* Support and coaching of subject matter experts, SIPOC owners, and process stakeholders in business process design, process mapping, business analysis, workflow optimization, user story development, and organizational readiness activities
* Facilitation of cross-functional collaboration across Clarification & Logistics, Global Order Management, Engineering, Field Service, and Service Operations to drive process harmonization, operational excellence, and end-to-end process integration
* Translation of business requirements into process definitions, system requirements, user stories, and continuous improvement initiatives supporting PLM360, Teamcenter, SAP S/4HANA, and enterprise digital solutions
* Planning and delivery of knowledge transfer, stakeholder engagement, training programs, workshops, user acceptance testing, feedback management, change communication, and business adoption monitoring
* Creation of leadership transparency through transformation reporting, readiness assessments, risk management, stakeholder communication, and support of sustainable organizational change and future operating model development

What You Bring
* Longstanding experience in business transformation, digital transformation, process management, operational excellence, continuous improvement, or large-scale ERP and enterprise system implementation programs
* Strong understanding of service operations, clarification processes, logistics management, supply chain processes, Global Order Management, Engineering, and Field Service environments
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, PLM systems, Teamcenter PLM360, ERP platforms, requirements management, business process management, and process harmonization initiatives
* Proven capability in coordinating complex cross-functional projects, stakeholder management, organizational alignment, business readiness, and global transformation programs within international environments
* Strong facilitation, communication, coaching, networking, workshop moderation, process mapping, workflow design, business analysis, and user story development skills
* Analytical and structured working style, independent and collaborative mindset, knowledge of change management and training concepts, excellent English communication skills, and German language skills as an advantage

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 
* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an SAP HANA Performance Team Leader to plan, execute, and validate the performance of SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV and AOS. This role is responsible for qualifying our software to meet SAP benchmark targets and certifying third-party OEM servers for inclusion in SAP’s certified hardware directory.

About the Team

Nutanix's Solutions & Performance Engineering team is a globally distributed organization of architects, performance engineers, and industry specialists focused on validating, optimizing, and accelerating customer success across strategic workloads and industry ecosystems.

Your Role

- Manage a team of remote employees and subcontractors to benchmark SAP HANA and other SAP software components on bare-metal servers. Virtualize similar configurations on Nutanix AHV using the same hardware to identify and improve performance differences between virtualization and bare metal.
- Deploy and troubleshoot various SAP HANA configurations, and establish and document the Nutanix best practices for this workload.
- Identify new strategies and configurations to improve SAP HANA performance on new software versions and denser hardware specifications that expose performance issues in the platform software.
- Work with core engineering teams to troubleshoot performance issues impacting SAP HANA and determine root causes that can be corrected through code changes.
- Deploy new hardware infrastructure in the SAP Linux lab in Walldorf, Germany, and manage infrastructure dependencies.
- Build strong relationships at SAP Headquarters in Walldorf, Germany to gain support from key stakeholders.
- Align Nutanix strategic outcomes with SAP strategic outcomes and influence SAP stakeholders to support Nutanix goals.
- Guide teams in using SAP HANA test harness tools, including SAP validation and certification suites. Serve as a subject matter expert to support performance teams in qualifying and certifying our solution.
- Analyze results from SAP validation and certification suites, compare them to SAP's KPI thresholds, diagnose failures, and drive issues to root cause across the full stack.
- Provision, configure, and troubleshoot SAP HANA parameters, SLES/RHEL for SAP tuning, vCPU/NUMA topology, kernel scheduling, general storage topologies, virtual storage controllers, and network fabrics.
- Experience with automating hardware and software deployments, infrastructure as code, and APIs.
- Ability to explore how AI can be used to automate processes further using advanced AI models.
- Understand the impact of new CPU and memory innovations on SAP HANA workloads and how Nutanix AHV and AOS must evolve to achieve performance benchmarks close to bare metal.
- Understand both scale-up and scale-out HANA and other key architectures of the SAP HANA database.
- Assist in producing written artifacts including SAP Notes, best practice guides, test plans, and KPI result packages for SAP submissions.
- Develop sizing guidelines, configuration recommendations, and reference architectures for SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV/AOS.
- Help customers and Nutanix sellers on large deals involving SAP HANA.
- Work with hardware OEMs to enable them to achieve their own hardware validations for SAP HANA with Nutanix.
- Assist with Nutanix support escalations.

What You Will Bring

- 5+ years in SAP HANA infrastructure or general database performance engineering, with at least 2 years focused on virtualized HANA.
- Deep Linux OS experience
- Experience with Nutanix HCI
- Performance monitoring tools
- Hands-on experience running SAP HANA test harness validation and certification suites, interpreting KPI results, especially storage latency and throughput tests, and understanding the reasons for test failures.
- Working knowledge of SAP HANA, the SAP HANA hardware directory, and, ideally, SAP's certification requirements for HCI and virtualized deployments.
- Strong Linux performance skills on SLES for SAP or RHEL for SAP, including hugepages, C-states and power governors, NUMA topology, SNC2, I/O schedulers, and the standard observability toolkit (perf, sar, iostat, blktrace, numastat, ftrace).
- Practical experience with virtualization performance, including CPU pinning and NUMA alignment, vCPU-to-pCPU ratios, memory reservation, and virtual storage and network path behavior.
- Nutanix AHV/AOS experience is strongly preferred. ESXi or KVM experience will be considered if the candidate can demonstrate relevant expertise.
- Comfortable with distributed storage concepts, including replication factor, data locality, write path and oplog behavior, and understanding latency percentiles.
- Scripting for automation and analysis (Python, Bash) and familiarity with Ansible or Terraform for repeatable lab builds.
- Excellent communication skills in both English and German, with the ability to engage meaningfully with customers.

Great to have

- Direct involvement in prior SAP HANA hardware, HCI, or cloud certification submissions.
- Experience with SAP HANA System Replication, scale-out landscapes, and HA/DR validation under fault injection.
- Familiarity with SAP application-layer benchmarking (SD benchmark, BW/4HANA or S/4HANA workload profiles) in addition to infrastructure KPIs.
- Nutanix certification (NCP/NCM) or SAP HANA Technology certification.

Senior Software Developer

Remuneration Group 13 | Limited: 2 years with the option to extend | Starting date: 01.12.2026 | ID: APMA007/2026 | Deadline: 11.10.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The Photo Injector Test Facility PITZ in Zeuthen (near Berlin) is one of the leading international groups for developing modern photo injectors and their applications. Current R&D goals of PITZ include improving the electron source brightness beyond state of the art for X‑ray Free Electron Lasers as well as applications of high brightness beams, e. g. for most modern cancer radiation therapies like FLASH‑RT and SFRT (FLASHlab@PITZ). The Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory (CTAO) is the next-generation, ground-based facility for very-high-energy gamma-ray astronomy. It will feature two massive telescope arrays deployed across both the Northern and Southern hemispheres. Operations and scientific data acquisition within the observatory are managed by the Array Control and Data Acquisition (ACADA) system. Within ACADA, the Resource Manager (RM) handles infrastructure administration and system supervision, while the Central Control (CC) orchestrates the execution of astronomical observation workflows.

As software developer, you will work for PITZ to develop server software for the accelerator control system, as well as for the ACADA system's RM and CC subsystems.

About your role:

- Development of server software for the control of different devices at PITZ using the DOOCS API
- Integration of applications into the accelerator control system
- Design and implement core operational subsystems as distributed, container-based software based on structural and behavioural design models
- Develop the orchestration logic to manage dynamic hardware groupings and automate workflows, alongside hierarchical, fault-tolerant architectures for system lifecycles and automated recovery

About you:

- University degree in computer science, physics, mathematics, engineering or related subject, or comparable qualification
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong professional experience in C++ and Java; proficiency in Python is advantageous
- Deep knowledge of OOP, functional programming, data structures, and concurrency/multithreading
- Familiarity with state-machine design patterns and distributed consensus mechanisms.
- Proven background in control systems, real-time programming, process automation, or SCADA architectures
- Experience developing communication protocols for hardware and device interfacing
- Strong proficiency in Linux environments and modern DevOps practices (TDD, CI/CD, build automation, Git)
- Strong English communication skills for collaborating in an international, multi-disciplinary team
- Good German communication skills are preferable

Good reasons to join:

- An international research campus enables you to think outside the box
- Basic, materials and applied research broaden your horizons
- Collaborate with exceptional colleagues and researchers
- Our own particle accelerator

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50 %). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV‑AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For our location in Zeuthen we are seeking:

PhD student for TIQTOC optical atomic clock experiment for Ultra-light Dark Matter

Remuneration Group E13 | Limited: 3 years | Starting date: 01.01.2027 | ID: APDO006/2026 | Deadline: open | Part-time

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The Zeuthen location of DESY has a strong focus on astroparticle and particle physics (gamma-ray and neutrino astronomy, and collider particle physics). The experimental groups are accompanied by a strong theory group. DESY Zeuthen is responsible for developing and delivering detectors for astroparticle and particle physics experiments, and is actively engaged in R&D for future applications.

With the Centre for Quantum Technology and Applications (CQTA), DESY Zeuthen is taking a leading role in applying quantum technology to challenges in particle and astroparticle physics. A new search for the effects of ultralight dark matter is being constructed, using ultra-sensitive optical atomic clocks as the sensing element. The post holder will contribute to this search, developing a test setup for networked clock comparison and frequency stabilisation. The post holder will also help to develop the procedures to collect and analyse the frequency comparisons, forming the basis of fundamental physics searches for (e.g.) ultralight dark matter.

About your role:

- Active role in developing test infrastructure for optical atomic clocks and comparison to reference clocks
- Develop instrumentation for measuring fundamental constants
- Participate in building up clock-based experiments at Humboldt University, DESY, Heidelberg or U. Birmingham
- Analyse experimental atomic clock data and participate in the interpretation of results

About you:

- Experience in one of the relevant physics fields (e.g. particle, atomic/nuclear physics, quantum optics) with Master's degree or equivalent
- Experience with detector physics, with good computer programming skills
- Very good command of English is required and knowledge of German is of advantage
- Willingness to travel and participate in working meetings, conferences, and field work abroad (e.g. at MPIK Heidelberg)
- Strong motivation, very good organizational skills, resilience; ability to work in teams and excellent communication skills

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the

TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information please contact Prof. Steven Worm at +49 33762-7-7208 [(steven.worm@desy.de).](https://mailto:(steven.worm@desy.de)

DESY in Zeuthen does not grant doctoral degrees directly but collaborates with the University of Potsdam or the Humboldt University. CHILD PSYCHOLOGIST / KINDERPSYCHOLOGE (M/W/D) – ENGLISH-SPEAKING POSITION

Kennziffer: Child Psychologist

ABOUT US:

Joy Center Family Institute is a multidisciplinary clinic specializing in child development, emotional well-being, and family support. Located in Böblingen (Stuttgart), we serve a diverse international community, including civilians families connected to the U.S. military.

We are known for our holistic, relationship-based, and play-centered therapy approach, following developmental models like DIR/FLOORTIME. Our mission is to empower children and families while nurturing growth, connection, and emotional well-being.

WE ARE CONTINUOUSLY EXPANDING OUR TEAM AND ARE CURRENTLY HIRING:

• Clinical Child Psychologists.
• Licensed Psychotherapists (able to work in Germany).
• Occupational Therapists.
• Speech and Language Therapists.

CURRENT VACANCY: Clinical Child Psychologist / Psychotherapist.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• THERAPEUTIC WORK: Provide individual and family-based psychological therapy for children aged 2-15. Focus areas often include developmental challenges, emotional regulation, behavioral concerns, social skills, and attachment-based issues.
• DEVELOPMENTAL FOCUS: Apply relationship-based, play-based models such as DIR/Floortime to foster emotional and developmental growth.
• ASSESSMENTS: Conduct psychological assessments and developmental screenings as needed.
• FAMILY SUPPORT: Engage, coach, and collaborate with parents and caregivers as part of each child's therapeutic journey.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY TEAM COLLABORATION: Participate in regular weekly supervision and team case discussions with other psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech/language therapists.
• DOCUMENTATION: Maintain accurate, timely clinical notes and assessment reports.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

• Degree in Psychology (Master's or Doctorate level).
• Licensed as a CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGIST or PSYCHOLOGICAL PSYCHOTHERAPIST with eligibility to practice in Germany (e.g., approbation or equivalent).
• Experience working with young children and families, ideally with ages 2 to 15.
• Familiarity with developmental models such as DIR/Floortime, play therapy, or other child-centered approaches (or willingness to learn).
• English fluency (our client base is international).
• Strong interpersonal skills, flexibility, and genuine passion for child development and family-centered work.

WHAT WE OFFER:

• FULL-TIME POSITION: 40 hours per week, with a balance between clinical work (28 hours) and time for documentation, supervision, and team meetings (12 hours).
• ONGOING SUPERVISION: Weekly individual and group supervision sessions plus staff meetings for professional growth and peer support.
• PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: Opportunities for continued training and workshops.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY ENVIRONMENT: Work alongside a diverse and supportive team of psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech-language therapists.
• MEANINGFUL WORK: Directly impact the lives of children and families in a nurturing, play-based setting.

LEARN MORE:

About Us

What if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.

Your Role & Mission

The mission of the Flash team at Forto is to fundamentally redesign operations processes by leveraging automation and intelligent decision-making to handle shipments more efficiently. We aim to scale CoPilot so that it becomes the primary system used by operations managers, enabling them to be more effective and efficient in their daily work.

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Flash team, you will help build AI-driven solutions and the CoPilot that powers our logistics operations. You will maintain and evolve a sophisticated event-driven, distributed architecture designed to answer one key question:

How do we improve shipment handling and bring efficiency to our operations teams at scale?

From quotation and rate management, to shipment execution and schedule optimization (capacity utilization and GP optimization), to carrier integrations and automated data extraction from unstructured sources (emails, PDFs, spreadsheets), this role focuses on building reliable, data-heavy systems that directly impact revenue and operational performance.

What you will do

- Design, build, and evolve scalable and resilient backend systems
- Contribute to an event-driven, distributed architecture
- Work on AI-adjacent systems (integration, orchestration, data-heavy workflows)
- Own services end-to-end (design, implementation, documentation, operation)
- Collaborate closely with product managers, operations, and other engineers
- Communicate clearly with stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs
- Contribute to technical standards and best practices within the team
- Foster a culture of excellence by coaching team members in best practices for backend engineering, domain-driven design, and navigating the complexities of the logistics domain.

Required Skills and Experience

- Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis, particularly as they apply to large-scale data processing and financial calculations.
- Proven professional software craftsmanship, with a focus on building high-quality, maintainable, and testable code (an understanding of TDD is a plus).
- Expertise in designing and implementing large-scale, event-driven microservices architectures and robust APIs, with a keen understanding of data consistency in distributed systems.
- Deep understanding of synchronous vs. asynchronous communication patterns and their impact on system performance and reliability
- Hands-on experience developing distributed backend applications, with a strong focus on data consistency, system quality, low latency, and high availability.
- Proficiency in microservices, with hands-on experience in backend technologies such as Node.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration for deploying and managing scalable pricing services.
- Experience with cloud providers (AWS or GCP preferred) for deploying and managing highly available and scalable applications.
- A collaborative, team-oriented mindset with strong critical product thinking and a sense of ownership over the accuracy and effectiveness of pricing data.
- Fluent in English, both verbal and written, for effective communication within a global team.

Preferred Skills and Experience

- Experience integrating AI/LLM-powered features into user faced applications
- Experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in complex product domains

Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit! 

Why work with us?

Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.

jobs.description:
At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.

Senior Principal Scientist (all genders) - External API Development for New Chemical Entities

You are an experienced synthetic and process chemist with the ambition to shape the chemical foundation of our R&D pipeline for new chemical entities (NCEs) by designing, developing, and enabling synthetic routes that evolve into robust API manufacturing processes in partnership with our external CDMO network.

In this Senior Principal Scientist (all genders) position within global CMC teams, you define and drive the DS strategy and are accountable for the DS contribution to the overall CMC package. Serving as the central interface between internal stakeholders and external partners, you lead chemical process development and API supply activities, enabling phase-appropriate, scalable, and sustainable manufacturing processes that ensure timely API delivery, robust product quality, and cost efficiency.

YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

- Provide scientific leadership for the design, assessment, and optimization of synthetic routes for new APIs in preclinical and clinical phases, with a focus on speed, quality, cost, sustainability, and process understanding
- Represent Drug Substance (DS) in global CMC development project teams and contribute to key scientific, strategic, and portfolio decisions, while ensuring a coherent two-way flow of strategy, decisions, risks, and progress between the internal global CMC team and external CDMO activities
- Guide and challenge route design and synthetic methodology choices at external CDMOs, translating SAR-driven chemistry into scalable routes for preclinical and clinical supply and future production in alignment with the internal DS development strategy
- Oversee external API campaigns for toxicology studies and clinical trials, including planning, risk assessment, supply-demand alignment, and budget oversight
- Steer process transfers between external partners and into internal development or external manufacturing, ensuring knowledge continuity and phase-appropriate documentation
- Contribute to robust, phase-appropriate control strategies. Co-author and review the Drug Substance sections of regulatory filings (IND/IMPD and briefing documents) and support responses to health authority questions
- Provide CMC DS assessments for in-licensing opportunities
- Provide chemical expertise and pragmatic troubleshooting across the internal and external manufacturing network. Actively contribute to the chemistry community by sharing knowledge and driving innovation across organizational boundaries

WHO YOU ARE

- Ph.D. in Chemistry or a related science, with extensive experience in the pharmaceutical industry, including an understanding of GLP/GMP and regulatory expectations
- Strong background in synthetic chemistry, with an excellent understanding of reagents, methodologies, and reaction mechanisms, plus a solid grasp of analytical techniques
- Experience in the CMC development of peptides is a plus
- Experience in steering external partners (CROs/CDMOs) or working across an external manufacturing network is a clear advantage
- Proven ability to represent chemistry and Drug Substance in interdisciplinary CMC or project teams and to act as an accountable interface between the internal organization and external partners
- A strategic thinker with the ability to think innovatively, develop and analyze multiple solutions to complex chemistry problems, and challenge the status quo
- Strong communication and project management skills across scientific disciplines, cultures, and organizational boundaries, combined with assertiveness, service orientation, and enjoyment of cross-functional teamwork
- Fluency in English (negotiation level), both written and spoken; German is an asset and willingness to learn German is required

WHAT WE OFFER

Our benefits package is flexible, appreciative, and tailored to your lifestyle, because: What matters to you, matters to us!

- We ensure your financial stability with a competitive salary between 109.800€ and 138.500€ per year (full-time) plus a variable component and a global equity-based cash plan. Your compensation is based on your qualifications, skills, and professional experience.
- Your family is a top priority. We offer loving company daycare centers at multiple locations, support in finding childcare, time off for the care of elderly or dependent family members, summer camps for children, and much more.
- We support your professional growth by providing access to learning and development opportunities, training programs through the Bayer Learning Academy, development dialogues, as well as coaching and mentoring programs.
- We promote health awareness and opportunities for selfcare through various measures, such as free health checks with the company doctor.
- We emb  diversity by providing an inclusive work environment in which you are welcomed, supported, and encouraged to bring your whole self to work.

Be You. Be Bayer.
